preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parser WHERE dataset_name = 'lu_pep_eu_commission'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO parser ( list_provider_id, name, description, dataset_name, source_id, plugin_id, plugin_url, data_source_type, parser_kind, source_location, parameters, refresh_hours, retention_months, licence, attribution, enabled, created_at ) SELECT p.id, 'Commissaire européen luxembourgeois', 'Commissaire européen luxembourgeois en fonction et anciens commissaires récents', 'lu_pep_eu_commission', s.id, 'lu-pep-eu-commission', 'D:/test parser 2/plugins/swiftcheck-aml-lu-pep-eu-commission-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar', 'HTTP_FILE', 'WEB_PAGE', 'https://commission.europa.eu/about/organisation/college-commissioners_fr', '{"yearsAfterEnd": "5", "sourceUrl": "https://commission.europa.eu/about/organisation/college-commissioners_fr"}', 24, 12, NULL, 'Commission européenne, commission.europa.eu', TRUE, NOW() FROM list_provider p LEFT JOIN pep_source s ON s.url = 'https://commission.europa.eu/about/organisation/college-commissioners_fr' WHERE p.code = 'EU-COM';
INSERT INTO parser_coverage (parser_id, function_id) SELECT p.id, f.id FROM parser p JOIN pep_category cat ON cat.code = 'LU-EU' JOIN pep_function f ON f.category_id = cat.id AND (f.label LIKE '%Commission%' OR f.id = 17) WHERE p.dataset_name = 'lu_pep_eu_commission';
